options.label: Later; scrolling the cards is enough for now

why: The zone, literally. One card fills the window: J and K to move, 1–4 to pick, Enter to take my recommendation (only when I'm sure, never on a look-closer card), N for a note, E for done, Esc out. "5 of 7" at the top. That's Linear Triage's number keys and Superhuman's flow, and the Flex design already has the screen (design/ReviewMode.dc.html).
Flex has built it. See Review mode and Picked in the walkthrough above: the segmented progress bar, media on the right, the key strip, and "Handled · next card".
